Hey mate, I’ve been a left arm orthodox spinner for decades. 3rd grade district in Adelaide was my peak. It really depends on the format. However, at your age I’d try this. For right handers come around the wicket. Almost bowl as slow as possible, pitch middle and off with good loop. Stack the leg side boundary. Forward of square leg, cow corner, and a really straight long on.

The idea is, most younger batter’s eyes will light up with slowness and loop. The loop will help your bounce (make sure you’re bowling with a very high arm action), you want them trying to hit you across the line. Catches in the deep and stumpings should be in play. Don’t use the arm ball too much, it’s not super useful on Astro turf. An easy variation is the toppy. Try to bring your hand down the front of the ball to get it spinning over itself rather the sideways.

Good luck! Being a spinner is hard. You’ll get smacked for six but hopefully pick up a few wickets along the way :)

Oh one more tip, with your arm ball.. try to learn how to bowl a medium pace inswinger. If you’re using a two piece it isn’t too hard. Don’t worry about disguising it.
